emails.subject: Demand letter - Victor Vasquez
emails.body:
Hello Pedro,

We received the attached demand letter from counsel for Victor Vasquez, who was terminated in August. The letter alleges wrongful termination and retaliation and demands $450,000. I've put a hold on the personnel file. How should we respond?

Regards,
Whitney

Best,
Kenji
